source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactivity of halogenoalkanes (PDF 78).

blocks.text: Halogenoalkane, R-X, ke do hisse hain: alkyl group jis ke halogen se jure carbon par juzwi musbat charge hai, aur halogen atom jis par juzwi manfi charge hai. Tajarbaat dikhate hain ke carbon-halogen bond ki mazbooti reactivity ka asal amil hai: bond jitna kamzor, utni aasani se toot'ta aur molecule utna zyada reactive.

blocks.caption: C-X bonds ki bond energies (kitab ka Table 21.1)

blocks.text: Sab se kamzor bonds wale iodo compounds sab se zyada reactive aur fluoro compounds sab se kam hain: R-I > R-Br > R-Cl > R-F. C-F bond itna mazboot hai ke fluoroalkanes aam halaat mein react nahi karte. Doosre amil, jaise bond polarity, steric hindrance aur inductive effects, bhi reactivity par asar kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Fluoroalkanes par nucleophiles ka hamla kam kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: C-F bond sab se mazboot carbon-halogen bond hai (Table 21.1 mein 467 kJ/mol), is liye ise torna bohat mushkil hai.

items: Reactivity zyada tar C-X bond ki mazbooti se tay.
R-I > R-Br > R-Cl > R-F; fluoroalkanes kam reactive.
